archetype: Archetype 5 (Jewel & Luxury) infused with Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast)
aesthetic_vibe: Bloomberg Terminal × Stripe Dashboard × Linear. Weighty, trustworthy, executive, data-dense but never cluttered.

rules.table_header: text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 bg-slate-50

spacing_and_layout.grid_strategy: Control Room Grid: Dense, compact spacing (gap-4 or gap-6). Heavy reliance on pure HTML/Tailwind HTML table tags for data density, avoiding overly padded Shadcn Card components for raw data.

buttons.secondary: bg-white border border-[#E1E6ED] text-[#0A1F44] hover:bg-slate-50 rounded-sm font-medium px-4 py-2 transition-colors shadow-sm
buttons.danger: bg-white border border-red-500 text-red-600 hover:bg-red-50 rounded-sm px-4 py-2 font-medium transition-colors

auth_background.description: Abstract architectural background, dark navy blue and subtle gold accents for Sign-in/Sign-up split screen

onboarding_art.description: Abstract glowing gold nodes on a deep navy blue background, representing a 'Data Trust Map'. Use this in the onboarding stub landing page.

avatars.description: African business executive portrait (use in member list table)
African business executive portrait (use in member list table)

interactions_and_motion.hover_states: Crisp and immediate. Buttons lift -translate-y-[1px] and gain a shadow-md. Links transition color in 150ms ease-in-out.
interactions_and_motion.focus_states: High contrast focus rings. focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-[#C9A961] focus-visible:outline-none.
interactions_and_motion.dialogs: Fade in with a slight scale up (95% -> 100%). Backdrop blur is highly recommended (backdrop-blur-sm bg-[#0A1F44]/40) for executive gravitas.
interactions_and_motion.data_testid: MANDATORY. All interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs, dialog triggers, list items) MUST include data-testid attributes formatted in kebab-case (e.g. data-testid='tenant-settings-export-btn').

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Shadcn UI components heavily but customize their default Vercel radii from rounded-md to rounded-sm to match the linear/stripe 'Bloomberg' aesthetic.
The App Shell should feature a deep Navy (#0A1F44) top header and left navigation bar, framing a light gray/white content canvas.
Ensure 'Generous whitespace' is applied via large padding (p-8) on page layouts, but keep data tables tight and information-dense.
For the Onboarding stub, use the `onboarding_art` image as a hero or split-screen visual to create a premium first impression.
When creating the Settings table, use the provided avatar images for the member list.
The 'Danger Zone' for archiving a tenant should clearly stand out with red borders and text, visually distinct from the rest of the settings.
Use the Gold accent (#C9A961) sparingly but deliberately: active navigation markers, primary CTAs, and trust/verification icons.
Include an Audit Log panel in the settings or dashboard with a clean, timestamped timeline view.
Ensure the application strictly follows WCAG 2.1 AA baseline. Use high-contrast text against the light canvas and legible typography sizes.
In the future gates, you will implement Data Trust Maps, Signals, and LLM Chat. Set up the foundational structure in this MVP (empty states, placeholders, basic layouts) to support these modules.
Build standard JWT email/password auth screens using the `auth_background` image.
